subject: Post-demo token economics sync — runway scenarios & contingency top-up
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Liu <matt@datwave.ai>, Susan Park <susan@datawave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + runway scenarios (asking for a quick confirm)

Hi Matt / Susan —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap from our side and two asks so we can model a concrete pilot top-up: 

Recap (2 min):
- You showed the ingest profile (mostly batched nightly enrichment + realtime inference for alerts).
- Target latency for customer-facing feature: p95 < 350ms for single-turn generations.
- Expected pilot length: 6 weeks (proof of concept to evaluate cost and quality).

Asks: 
1) Can you confirm a conservative daily token profile you expect during pilot (low / typical / high peaks)? A quick table like: 50k / 200k / 600k tokens/day is perfect.
2) What is the internal budget band for this pilot? You mentioned a rough $/month range on the call — please confirm top and bottom.

Based on the call I sketched three runway scenarios and a conditional top-up pathway (below) so we can approve credits quickly if you hit expected velocity. If you confirm the numbers we’ll push an addendum to your trial with one-click signing.

Runway scenarios (estimated $/1M tokens):
- Conservative: $750 / 1M tokens — for batched inference + aggressive batching settings
- Typical: $1,100 / 1M tokens — mixed realtime + batch workload
- Peak: $1,700 / 1M tokens — realtime-heavy, lower batching, larger sequence lengths

Conditional top-up pathway (proposal):
- Initial free credit: $10k applied now to cover 2 weeks of typical usage.
- Triggered top-up: If average daily tokens across a 7-day window >= 250k/day, Redwood will unlock a one-time $15k top-up to extend the pilot (requires approval and signed addendum).

If you confirm token-band and budget range I’ll circulate the short addendum and Ben will queue the credit approval on our side.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: dw-usage-snapshot.csv (stub: CSV with sample token counts by day)

From: Matt Liu <matt@datwave.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@datawave.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + runway scenarios (asking for a quick confirm)

Priya —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers from our side (rough estimates; we can tighten after the first week):
- Conservative: 40k tokens/day
- Typical: 210k tokens/day
- Peak: 620k tokens/day (expected on model retrain days + live campaigns)

Budget: Our pilot budget window is $8k — $20k for the 6-week POC. We’d prefer to keep expected spend around the lower half but can stretch to $20k if the results look strong.

A few clarifying Qs:
1) Does the conditional top-up require signatures from legal, or can we accept a short attach-and-sign via DocuSign (Susan will own legal loop)?
2) How do you measure "average daily tokens across a 7-day window"? Is it rolling average, and will we get token-level telemetry in the console?

Susan, looping you to confirm legal preference.

—Matt
Matt Liu
Head of Product, DataWave
matt@datwave.ai

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Liu <matt@datwave.ai>, Susan Park <susan@datawave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + runway scenarios (asking for a quick confirm)

Matt — perfect, thanks for confirming. Quick answers: 

1) Signature flow: DocuSign is fine. We’ll prepare a 1‑page addendum that is DocuSign-ready; legal review from your side is expected but we don’t need enterprise-level redlines for this top-up.

2) Measurement: We use rolling 7-day average of tokens consumed across all API requests for the account (visible in Console -> Usage). We’ll provide a read-only link for the pilot so you can see token-level telemetry and the metric that will trigger the top-up.

Next steps I’ll take after your sign-off:
- Ben will queue internal credit approval and attach the addendum.
- I’ll enable the read-only usage dashboard for your team.
- You sign the DocuSign addendum and we apply the initial $10k credit.

Ben — can you confirm you can approve the conditional $15k top-up pending the trigger and a signed addendum? If there is any change to the wording we should catch it now.

Thanks —
Priya

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Matt Liu <matt@datwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + runway scenarios (asking for a quick confirm)

Hi team —

Ben here from GTM ops. I’ve reviewed the ask and can confirm we have pre-approved the following for the DataWave pilot (DW-2027-42):
- Initial credit: $10,000 to be applied once DocuSign is completed.
- Contingent top-up: $15,000 one-time credit to be applied automatically upon meeting the rolling 7-day >= 250k tokens/day threshold.

Operational notes:
- I attached a short PDF addendum (topup-addendum.pdf) that contains the exact trigger language and the HubSpot deal id. Please review.
- We’ll enable a read-only Console link and a Slack webhook to notify both teams when token thresholds are crossed.

If legal prefers a slightly different phrase for the trigger we can swap "rolling 7-day average >= 250k" with the equivalent multi-day-window wording; we just need the signed addendum.

Matt / Susan: I’ll send the DocuSign envelope by EOD.

Best —
Ben Carter
GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: topup-addendum.pdf (stub: 1-page addendum outlining credit amounts and trigger)

From: Matt Liu <matt@datwave.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@datawave.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + runway scenarios (asking for a quick confirm)

Ben / Priya —

Thanks, this looks good. Susan confirmed DocuSign is fine; she’ll route it through our legal and signers later today. We reviewed the addendum language and the trigger phrasing works for us (rolling 7-day avg >= 250k).

We’ll sign and you should see the initial $10k credit applied shortly after. Also appreciate the read-only console access — that will make it easy to track the runway.

Looking forward to the pilot —
Matt
